items.title: Bank Of America (BAC) Led Debt Financing For A Major Wealth Platform Deal
items.summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) acted as a lead arranger for private debt financing backing Vanguard Group's acquisition of Altruist. The financing supports Vanguard's purchase of digital wealth platform Altruist, a fintech provider serving financial advisers and investors. The deal underscores large banks' continued role in funding technology driven wealth management platforms that aim to modernize client service.
